raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00, and 345 txn_ids appear twice. The re-delivered copies store txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (1768543211000 = 2026-01-16 06:00:11, matching the original copy), which breaks the direct TIMESTAMP cast. Parsing epoch-ms values and keeping one row per txn_id (earliest ingest_ts) restores correct silver data, and the gold tables rebuild from it unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status, ingest_ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND rn = 1;"}}
